AP® Calculus AB/BC 2022 Scoring Guidelines
Scoring notes:
• A response that includes the substitution error of the form + + 2(n 1 1 ) 2n+3
x = x appearing as
2n 1 1 2n+2 + +
x = x in setting up a ratio is eligible for the first 3 points but does not earn the
fourth point.
• The first point is earned by presenting a correct ratio with or without absolute values.
• To earn the second point a response must:
o use the absolute value of the ratio, or resolve the lack of absolute values by concluding x2
< 1
(without any errors), and correctly evaluate the limit of the ratio, including correct limit
notation, and
o identify the interior of the interval of convergence. The response can use either interval notation
or the compound inequality − < 1 x < 1 ( x < 1 is insufficient).
• The only incorrect interval eligible for the third point is 0 < x < 1. In this case, to earn the third
point, the response needs to evaluate the general term at x = 1.
